paragraphs.text:
If your gun is handy, you can shoot at point-blank range (gain 
a bonus die). If you hit him, his associates back away. You grab 
the box and an attaché case, and go to 484.
If your Dodge was successful, you escape to 467. If you fail the 
Dodge roll, they grab you and pummel you with a vengeance (lose 
1D3+1 hit points). Fortunately, the police arrive and break up the 
fight. You are arrested. You remain in jail for 2D10 days before 
bail from abroad arrives to free you. Then go to any Bremen 
Location.
(478)
